name: Sword of Sharpness

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Light
powers.text: Magic action: the blade sheds bright light 10 ft and dim light 10 ft more, or stops.

summary: On a 20, an extra 4d6 Slashing, and another 20 lops off a limb. Objects it hits take maximum damage.
text: Against objects, every hit with this magic sword deals the maximum on its weapon damage dice. Against a creature, an attack roll of 20 adds 4d6 Slashing damage; then roll a d20 again, and on another 20 the blow severs one of the target's limbs (or a chunk of its body if it has none), with the DM ruling on the consequences. As a Magic action you can also make the blade shine, casting Bright Light out to 10 feet and Dim Light for 10 feet more; repeating the action or sheathing the sword puts the light out.
